delinquent.zh: 行為不良的青少年；違法者
ai: The court sent the young delinquent to a special school.
法院把這名行為不良的少年送進了特殊學校。
Many juvenile delinquents need guidance more than punishment.
許多少年犯需要的是輔導而不是懲罰。
He was delinquent in paying his rent for three months.
他有三個月沒付房租了。
The delinquent account was sent to a collection agency.
這個逾期未繳的帳戶被轉給了催收公司。

populous.zh: 人口眾多的；人口稠密的
ai: Indonesia is one of the most populous countries in the world.
印尼是世界上人口最多的國家之一。
The populous coastal region is crowded with traffic every morning.
這個人口稠密的沿海地區每天早上都塞滿了車。

ethernet.zh: 乙太網路（有線區域網路技術）
ai: Plug the Ethernet cable into the back of the computer.
把乙太網路線插到電腦後面。
The office uses Ethernet because it is faster than Wi-Fi.
辦公室使用乙太網路，因為它比無線網路快。
She made a funny quip about the long meeting.
她對這場冗長的會議說了一句好笑的俏皮話。
His quips kept everyone laughing during dinner.
他的妙語讓大家整頓晚餐都笑個不停。
"At least the food is cheap," he quipped.
「至少東西很便宜。」他打趣地說。
She quipped that she needed a vacation from her vacation.
她開玩笑說，自己需要從假期中再放個假。
The mayor gave the job to one of his old cronies.
市長把這份工作給了他的一位老死黨。
He spends every Friday night with his cronies at the bar.
他每週五晚上都和他的哥兒們在酒吧度過。
The movie seems to glorify war instead of showing its cost.
這部電影似乎在美化戰爭，而沒有呈現它的代價。
They gathered to glorify the hero with songs and speeches.
他們聚在一起用歌曲和演講來讚頌這位英雄。
She served ice cream with a thin vanilla wafer.
她端上了附有香草薄脆餅的冰淇淋。
The priest placed a wafer on his tongue.
神父把一片聖餅放在他的舌頭上。
Chips are made from thin silicon wafers.
晶片是由很薄的矽晶圓製成的。
The factory cuts each wafer into hundreds of tiny pieces.
工廠把每片晶圓切成數百個小單元。
The soup gave me a pleasant feeling of fullness.
這碗湯讓我有一種舒服的飽足感。
Fiber helps you enjoy a longer sense of fullness after meals.
纖維能讓你在飯後更久維持飽足感。
She spoke about the fullness of her life with gratitude.
她懷著感激談起自己生活的豐富充實。
The fullness of the wine surprised everyone at the table.
這款酒的醇厚度讓餐桌上的每個人都驚訝。
The dentist said I need to fill a cavity in my back molar.
牙醫說我後面的臼齒需要補一個蛀洞。
Children usually get their first molars around the age of six.
孩子通常在六歲左右長出第一顆臼齒。
In the story, the villagers think greed is sinful.
故事裡，村民認為貪婪是有罪的。
He felt sinful for eating the whole cake by himself.
他獨自吃完整個蛋糕，覺得自己罪孽深重。
Sprinkle some grated cheese over the pasta.
在義大利麵上撒些起司絲。
The salad had grated carrots and cabbage in it.
這份沙拉裡有紅蘿蔔絲和高麗菜絲。

grated.zh: 刨絲；磨碎（grate 的過去式）
ai: She grated the lemon peel into the batter.
她把檸檬皮刨成屑加進麵糊裡。
I grated a little ginger and added it to the soup.
我磨了一點薑加進湯裡。
The old tombstone was covered with moss.
那塊老墓碑上長滿了青苔。
His name was carved into a simple stone tombstone.
他的名字被刻在一塊樸素的石頭墓碑上。
Bright orange koi swam slowly in the garden pond.
亮橘色的錦鯉在庭院的池塘裡緩緩游動。
We bought some food to feed the koi at the temple.
我們買了一些飼料來餵寺廟裡的錦鯉。
The students studied an anatomical model of the heart.
學生們研究了一個心臟的解剖模型。
There are small anatomical differences between the two species.
這兩個物種在構造上有些微小的差異。
The reseller offers the same laptop at a lower price.
這位經銷商以較低的價格販售同一款筆電。
We buy our software through an authorized reseller.
我們透過授權經銷商購買軟體。
The children ran through the cornfield behind the farm.
孩子們在農場後面的玉米田裡奔跑。
A scarecrow stood in the middle of the cornfield.
一個稻草人站在玉米田中央。

balsamic.zh: 香醋的；香脂的（常指巴薩米克醋）
ai: I dressed the salad with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
我用橄欖油和巴薩米克醋來拌沙拉。
The balsamic glaze made the chicken taste sweet and rich.
巴薩米克醋醬汁讓這道雞肉吃起來又甜又濃郁。

rune.zh: 盧恩字母（古代北歐文字）
ai: The stone was carved with ancient runes.
那塊石頭上刻著古老的盧恩文字。
He studied how Vikings used runes to write short messages.
他研究維京人如何用盧恩字母書寫簡短訊息。

chunky.zh: 矮胖的；厚實的；有大塊料的
ai: The baby had chunky little legs and a big smile.
這個寶寶有一雙肉嘟嘟的小腿和大大的笑容。
She wore a chunky sweater to keep warm.
她穿了一件厚實的毛衣保暖。
I like chunky tomato sauce better than smooth sauce.
比起滑順的醬汁，我更喜歡有大塊番茄的醬汁。
She methodically checked every box in the storeroom.
她有條不紊地檢查了儲藏室裡的每一個箱子。
The team worked methodically to find the cause of the error.
團隊有系統地工作，想找出錯誤的原因。
Please change the filename before you save the document.
存檔之前請先修改檔案名稱。
The filename is too long, so the system rejected it.
這個檔名太長了，所以系統拒絕接受。
Extreme partisanship makes it hard for lawmakers to agree.
極端的黨派之爭讓議員們很難達成共識。
Many voters are tired of the partisanship in the news.
許多選民厭倦了新聞裡的黨派對立。
Historians discuss how one hegemonic power can shape world trade.
歷史學家討論一個霸權國家如何左右世界貿易。
The article criticizes the hegemonic influence of a few big media companies.
這篇文章批評少數大型媒體公司的支配性影響力。
The sofa has thick padding, so it is very comfortable.
這張沙發有厚厚的填充物，所以非常舒適。
Football players wear padding to protect their shoulders.
美式足球球員穿著護墊來保護肩膀。
Cut the padding and get to the point of your essay.
刪掉廢話，直接切入你文章的重點。
Most of the report was just padding to make it look longer.
這份報告大部分只是為了讓它看起來更長的灌水內容。
The village sits in a deep, forested valley.
這個村莊位於一座森林茂密的深谷裡。
About half of the island is forested.
這座島大約一半被森林覆蓋。
Drinking too much coffee can make gastritis worse.
咖啡喝太多會讓胃炎惡化。
The doctor said my stomach pain was caused by gastritis.
醫師說我的胃痛是胃炎造成的。
The kids threw snowballs at each other in the yard.
孩子們在院子裡互相丟雪球。
He packed a hard snowball and aimed it at the tree.
他捏了一顆硬雪球，瞄準那棵樹。
A small mistake can snowball into a huge problem.
一個小錯誤可能會愈滾愈大，變成大問題。
Her online business snowballed within a few months.
她的網路事業在幾個月內迅速壯大起來。
The wedding cake was covered with smooth white fondant.
那個婚禮蛋糕覆蓋著光滑的白色翻糖。
She rolled out the fondant and cut it into little stars.
她把翻糖擀開，切成小星星的形狀。
The river was too polluted for anyone to swim in.
這條河汙染得太嚴重，沒人能下去游泳。
People living in polluted cities often suffer from breathing problems.
住在空氣汙濁城市的人常有呼吸方面的問題。
Piracy was a serious danger for ships crossing the sea.
海盜行為曾經是橫越海洋的船隻面臨的嚴重威脅。
Several countries sent warships to fight piracy near the coast.
幾個國家派出軍艦在沿海一帶打擊海盜行為。
Software piracy costs companies a lot of money every year.
軟體盜版每年讓公司損失大量金錢。
The singer asked fans not to support music piracy.
這位歌手請歌迷不要支持盜版音樂。

discarded.zh: 丟棄；拋棄（discard 的過去式）
ai: She discarded the old magazines and cleaned her desk.
她把舊雜誌丟掉，整理了書桌。
He quietly discarded the plan after the first test failed.
第一次測試失敗後，他默默放棄了這個計畫。
Don't forget to deflate the beach ball before packing it.
打包前別忘了把沙灘球的氣放掉。
The tire began to deflate slowly after the nail went in.
釘子扎進去後，輪胎開始慢慢漏氣。
The bad news deflated everyone's excitement.
這個壞消息澆熄了大家的興奮之情。
Her sharp comment deflated his pride at once.
她尖銳的一句話立刻讓他的驕傲消了氣。
We picked fresh blackberries along the country path.
我們沿著鄉間小路採了新鮮的黑莓。
She made a pie with blackberry jam and apples.
她用黑莓果醬和蘋果做了一個派。
A small plant was growing in a crevice in the rock.
一棵小植物長在岩石的裂縫裡。
My keys fell into the crevice between the seats.
我的鑰匙掉進了座椅之間的縫隙裡。
He is famous for his flamboyant clothes and loud laugh.
他以花俏的衣著和響亮的笑聲聞名。
The singer made a flamboyant entrance in a bright red cape.
這位歌手穿著鮮紅色披風，以誇張的方式登場。
The man brandished a stick and shouted at the dog.
那個男人揮舞著一根棍子對著狗大叫。
She brandished the winning ticket in front of her friends.
她在朋友面前揮舞著中獎的彩券。
We shared a slice of strawberry cheesecake after dinner.
晚餐後我們分著吃了一片草莓起司蛋糕。
Her homemade cheesecake has a crunchy cookie crust.
她自製的起司蛋糕有酥脆的餅乾底。
He fell off his bike and broke his pelvis.
他從腳踏車上摔下來，骨盆骨折了。
The pelvis supports the weight of the upper body.
骨盆支撐著上半身的重量。
Salt air can tarnish silver jewelry quickly.
帶鹽分的空氣會讓銀飾很快失去光澤。
The scandal tarnished the company's good name.
這起醜聞玷汙了公司的好名聲。
The old spoons began to tarnish in the damp drawer.
那些舊湯匙放在潮濕的抽屜裡開始失去光澤。
Copper will tarnish if you leave it in the open air.
銅暴露在空氣中就會變得黯淡。
There was a dark tarnish on the old brass lamp.
那盞老黃銅燈上有一層暗色的鏽斑。
The tarnish on his reputation never fully went away.
他名聲上的汙點始終沒有完全消失。
She zipped up her parka before going out into the snow.
她出門走進雪地前拉上了派克大衣的拉鍊。
A warm parka is a must for winter hiking.
保暖的連帽厚外套是冬季健行的必備品。
The crowd cheered madly when the team scored.
球隊得分時，群眾瘋狂地歡呼。
He ran madly down the street looking for a taxi.
他在街上瘋狂地奔跑著找計程車。
They are madly in love with each other.
他們愛得死去活來。
She was madly jealous of her friend's new job.
她對朋友的新工作嫉妒得要命。
The nurse gave him morphine to ease the pain after surgery.
護理師給他打了嗎啡來緩解手術後的疼痛。
Doctors control morphine carefully because it can be addictive.
醫師對嗎啡管控得很嚴，因為它可能讓人上癮。
My mother was a homemaker who raised four children.
我母親是個家庭主婦，扶養了四個孩子。
He left his job to become a full-time homemaker.
他辭掉工作，成為全職的家庭主夫。
The little brat screamed until he got the toy.
那個被寵壞的小鬼尖叫著，直到拿到玩具為止。
Don't be such a brat and say thank you.
別這麼不懂事，說聲謝謝吧。
We hired a decorator to help us choose colors for the living room.
我們請了一位室內設計師幫忙挑選客廳的顏色。
The decorator suggested hanging a large mirror on the wall.
裝潢師建議在牆上掛一面大鏡子。
The decorator will start painting the hallway on Monday.
油漆工星期一會開始粉刷走廊。
In Britain, a decorator often paints and wallpapers rooms.
在英國，decorator 常指負責粉刷和貼壁紙的師傅。
Lymph helps the body fight infection.
淋巴液幫助身體對抗感染。
The doctor felt the lymph nodes in my neck.
醫師摸了摸我脖子上的淋巴結。
The equatorial regions are hot and rainy all year.
赤道地區一整年都炎熱多雨。
Equatorial forests are home to thousands of animal species.
赤道森林是數千種動物的家。
The king kept gold coins in a locked coffer.
國王把金幣放在上鎖的箱子裡。
The new tax will bring more money into the government's coffers.
新稅制將為政府的國庫帶來更多資金。
He pointed at the map with his forefinger.
他用食指指著地圖。
She held the tiny seed between her thumb and forefinger.
她用拇指和食指捏著那顆小種子。
"Practice makes perfect" is a maxim many teachers repeat.
「熟能生巧」是許多老師常說的格言。
My grandfather lived by the maxim that honesty is the best policy.
我祖父奉行「誠實為上策」這句格言過日子。
The novel is an allegory about power and greed.
這本小說是一則關於權力與貪婪的寓言。
Students read the story as an allegory of growing up.
學生們把這個故事當成成長的寓言來讀。

outgrow.zh: 長大到不再適合；長得比…快
ai: Kids outgrow their shoes so quickly.
小孩長得很快，鞋子沒多久就穿不下了。
He hopes his son will outgrow his fear of the dark.
他希望兒子長大後就不再怕黑。
A little critter ran across the path in front of us.
一隻小動物從我們面前的小路上跑過去。
The kids love to look for critters under the rocks.
孩子們喜歡在石頭底下找小生物。
She acted with great propriety at the formal dinner.
她在正式晚宴上表現得十分得體。
Some people questioned the propriety of his remarks.
有些人質疑他言論的恰當性。
The school offers experiential learning through field trips.
學校透過校外教學提供體驗式的學習。
Travel gives you experiential knowledge that books cannot.
旅行帶給你書本給不了的親身經驗。
The barrel was made of several wooden staves.
那個木桶是由幾片木桶板組成的。
The notes were written on a five-line stave.
音符被寫在五線譜上。
She ate a banana to stave off hunger until lunch.
她吃了一根香蕉，好撐到午餐前不餓。
The company took steps to stave off bankruptcy.
公司採取了各種措施來避免破產。
Heat the milk slowly until it begins to condense.
把牛奶慢慢加熱，直到它開始變濃稠。
Water vapor condenses on the cold window in the morning.
水蒸氣在早晨會凝結在冰冷的窗戶上。
Please condense your report into one page.
請把你的報告濃縮成一頁。
The editor condensed the long article into a short summary.
編輯把這篇長文精簡成一份簡短的摘要。
The case remains unsolved after ten years.
這個案子十年後仍未破獲。
Some math problems have stayed unsolved for centuries.
有些數學問題幾個世紀以來一直沒有解開。
He kept wanting more candy even after dinner.
他連晚餐後都還一直想吃更多糖果。
She left early, wanting to avoid the traffic.
她提早離開，想避開塞車。
The new design was found wanting in several ways.
這個新設計被發現在幾方面有所不足。
His effort was never wanting, even when the task was hard.
即使任務很難，他也從不缺乏努力。
Her pragmatism helped the team choose a realistic plan.
她的務實態度幫助團隊選了一個切合實際的計畫。
The mayor is known for his political pragmatism.
這位市長以政治上的務實作風聞名。
Asthma is a common affliction among city children.
氣喘是都市孩子常見的病痛。
She bore her afflictions with patience and humor.
她以耐心和幽默承受自己的苦難。

proverbial.zh: 眾所周知的；諺語中所說的
ai: He was the proverbial fish out of water at the party.
他在派對上就像俗話說的那條離水之魚。
After weeks of delays, the proverbial light at the end of the tunnel finally appeared.
拖延了幾週後，大家常說的隧道盡頭那道光終於出現了。
We walked on the beach at ebb when the tide was low.
我們在退潮時走在海灘上，那時潮水很低。
The team's energy was at a low ebb after the long trip.
長途旅行之後，隊伍的精力處於低潮。
The tide began to ebb, leaving shells on the sand.
潮水開始退去，在沙灘上留下貝殼。
His anger slowly ebbed as he listened to her.
他聽著她說話，怒氣慢慢消退了。
The artistry of the glass work amazed the visitors.
玻璃工藝的藝術性讓參觀者驚嘆不已。
You can see the chef's artistry in every dish.
你可以在每一道菜裡看到主廚的藝術功力。
She interspersed her speech with funny stories.
她在演講中穿插了一些有趣的故事。
The garden is interspersed with small ponds and stone paths.
這座花園裡點綴著小池塘和石頭小徑。
She was dismayed to find that the shop had closed.
她發現店已經關門，感到沮喪。
The dismayed fans stood quietly after the loss.
輸球之後，沮喪的球迷們靜靜站著。

dismayed.zh: 使驚愕；使氣餒（dismay 的過去式）
ai: The sudden price increase dismayed many customers.
突如其來的漲價讓許多顧客感到驚愕。
The long list of rules dismayed the new employees.
那一長串規定讓新員工們感到洩氣。

brunt.zh: 首當其衝的壓力；主要衝擊（bear the brunt）
ai: Small shops bore the brunt of the economic crisis.
小商店首當其衝承受了這場經濟危機的衝擊。
The coastal town took the brunt of the storm.
這個海岸小鎮承受了暴風雨的最大衝擊。
I don't want to disillusion him about his dream job.
我不想讓他對夢想中的工作幻想破滅。
The long, boring work soon disillusioned the young volunteers.
漫長又枯燥的工作很快讓年輕的志工們幻想破滅。
Many young voters feel disillusion with politics.
許多年輕選民對政治感到幻滅。
His disillusion grew as the project fell behind schedule.
隨著專案進度落後，他的幻滅感愈來愈深。

knockout.zh: 擊倒；令人驚豔的人事物
ai: The boxer won the fight by a knockout in the second round.
這位拳擊手在第二回合以擊倒獲勝。
Her new dress is a real knockout.
她的新洋裝真是令人驚豔。

knockout.zh: 擊倒的；淘汰制的；極出色的
ai: He landed a knockout punch and ended the match.
他揮出致命的一拳，結束了比賽。
The tournament uses a knockout format, so losers go home.
這場錦標賽採淘汰制，輸的人就要回家。

spooky.zh: 陰森的；令人毛骨悚然的
ai: The old house looked spooky at night.
那棟老房子在夜裡看起來陰森森的。
We told spooky stories around the campfire.
我們圍著營火講了恐怖故事。

impenetrable.zh: 無法穿透的；難以理解的
ai: The jungle was thick and impenetrable.
那片叢林濃密得無法穿越。
The contract was written in impenetrable legal language.
這份合約用的是令人難以理解的法律用語。
It is regrettable that so many people missed the show.
這麼多人錯過這場表演，真令人遺憾。
The company called the delay a regrettable mistake.
公司稱這次延誤是一個令人遺憾的錯誤。
He picked up a toothpick after finishing the meal.
他吃完飯後拿了一根牙籤。
Each small snack was held together with a toothpick.
每一塊小點心都用一根牙籤固定著。
He felt impotent as he watched the flood rise.
他看著洪水上漲，覺得自己無能為力。
The committee was impotent without support from the leaders.
沒有領導階層的支持，這個委員會形同無力。
The violinist played softly while guests arrived.
賓客抵達時，小提琴手輕柔地演奏著。
My sister dreams of becoming a famous violinist.
我姊姊夢想成為著名的小提琴家。
Demand for tickets has outstripped supply.
門票的需求已經超過供應。
She quickly outstripped her classmates in math.
她在數學上很快就超越了同學。
A good night's sleep has a restoring effect on the body.
一夜好眠對身體有恢復元氣的作用。
They enjoyed a quiet, restoring walk by the lake.
他們在湖邊安靜地散步，讓精神恢復過來。
After a fruitless search, we gave up looking for the key.
徒勞地找了一番之後，我們放棄找鑰匙了。
Their talks were fruitless, and nobody changed their mind.
他們的談判毫無成果，沒有人改變想法。
He blatantly ignored the sign and parked there anyway.
他公然無視告示牌，還是把車停在那裡。
The ad was blatantly false, so people complained.
那則廣告明目張膽地造假，所以民眾提出了抱怨。
She is a generous giver who donates to many charities.
她是個慷慨的捐贈者，捐款給許多慈善機構。
The giver of the gift left no name on the card.
送禮的人沒在卡片上留下名字。
Good friendship is built on reciprocity.
良好的友誼建立在互惠之上。
The two countries signed an agreement of trade reciprocity.
兩國簽署了貿易互惠協定。
In the sentence "Birds sing," the predicate is "sing."
在「Birds sing」這個句子裡，謂語是 sing。
The teacher asked us to underline the predicate in each sentence.
老師要我們在每個句子裡把謂語畫底線。
The plan is predicated on the idea that costs will stay low.
這個計畫是以成本維持低檔這個想法為基礎。
His argument predicates that people always act logically.
他的論點斷定人總是理性行事。
Delete any superfluous words from your essay.
把文章裡多餘的字刪掉。
The extra instructions were superfluous, since everyone already knew what to do.
那些額外的說明是多餘的，因為大家本來就知道該怎麼做。
Oops, I forgot to bring my wallet.
哎呀，我忘了帶錢包。
"Oops!" she said as the cup slipped from her hand.
杯子從她手中滑落時，她說：「哎呀！」
The neurologist ordered a scan to check her headaches.
神經科醫師安排了掃描來檢查她的頭痛。
My uncle works as a neurologist at a large hospital.
我叔叔在一家大醫院擔任神經科醫師。
We tried everything to fix the car, but to no avail.
我們什麼辦法都試過想修好車，但都沒用。
His apologies were of little avail to the angry customers.
他的道歉對憤怒的顧客沒什麼幫助。
Visitors can avail themselves of free Wi-Fi in the lobby.
訪客可以使用大廳的免費無線網路。
She availed herself of the chance to study abroad.
她把握機會出國留學。
She handled the difficult situation admirably.
她把這個困難的局面處理得令人欽佩。
The young team performed admirably under pressure.
這支年輕的隊伍在壓力下表現出色。
I will go to the meeting in his stead.
我會代替他去開會。
She spoke in her sister's stead at the ceremony.
她在典禮上代替姊姊發言。

stead.zh: 益處；用處（stand in good stead）
ai: His early training stood him in good stead later in life.
他早期的訓練在日後對他大有幫助。
Learning to cook will stand you in good stead at college.
學會做菜在大學裡會對你很有幫助。
Critics lauded the film for its honest story.
評論家稱讚這部電影故事真誠。
The mayor lauded the volunteers for their hard work.
市長讚揚志工們的辛勤付出。
The young scientist received laud from her colleagues.
這位年輕科學家受到同事們的讚揚。
The book won high laud from readers around the world.
這本書贏得了全球讀者的高度讚譽。
Regrettably, the concert has been canceled.
很遺憾，這場演唱會已經取消了。
We were regrettably unable to attend your wedding.
很可惜，我們無法出席你的婚禮。
We retraced our steps to find the lost phone.
我們沿著原路折返去找遺失的手機。
The detective retraced the thief's movements on the night of the crime.
偵探重新追查竊賊案發當晚的行蹤。
The Andean villages are known for colorful woven cloth.
安第斯山區的村莊以色彩繽紛的織布聞名。
We saw Andean condors flying above the mountain peaks.
我們看到安地斯神鷹在山峰上空飛翔。
Don't overdo the salt, or the soup will taste too strong.
鹽別放太多，不然湯會太鹹。
He overdid his workout and could barely walk the next day.
他運動過量，隔天幾乎走不了路。
The philosopher explained the dialectic between freedom and order.
這位哲學家解釋了自由與秩序之間的辯證關係。
Socrates used a kind of dialectic, asking question after question.
蘇格拉底用一種辯證法，一個接一個地提問。
The class discussed a dialectic approach to the problem.
班上討論了處理這個問題的辯證方法。
Her dialectic thinking helped her see both sides of the issue.
她辯證式的思考幫助她看見議題的兩面。
Many religions speak of the transcendence of the self.
許多宗教都談到超越自我。
The music seemed to reach a kind of transcendence.
那段音樂似乎達到了一種超凡的境界。
I tried to dissuade him from quitting his job.
我試著勸他不要辭職。
Bad weather did not dissuade the fans from coming to the game.
壞天氣沒有阻止球迷來看比賽。
I wholeheartedly agree with your idea.
我全心全意同意你的想法。
She threw herself wholeheartedly into the new project.
她全心投入這個新專案。
The carver shaped the wood into a small bird.
雕刻師把木頭刻成一隻小鳥。
My father used the carver to slice the roast at dinner.
晚餐時我爸爸用切肉刀切烤肉。
She has a few freckles across her nose.
她的鼻子上有幾顆雀斑。
His freckles show up more in the summer sun.
夏天陽光下他的雀斑會更明顯。
The strong wind uprooted several old trees.
強風把好幾棵老樹連根拔起。
We uprooted the weeds from the vegetable garden.
我們把菜園裡的雜草連根拔除了。
The war uprooted thousands of families from their homes.
戰爭使成千上萬個家庭離開了家園。
It was hard to uproot the kids and move to another city.
要讓孩子們離開熟悉的環境搬到另一個城市並不容易。
She refused to divulge the secret to anyone.
她拒絕把這個祕密透露給任何人。
The company will not divulge customer information.
公司不會洩露客戶的資料。
The trip was delayed because of unforeseen problems.
由於發生了意料之外的問題，這趟旅行延後了。
We keep some money aside for unforeseen costs.
我們留一些錢以備不時之需的額外支出。
Teenagers often use slang that their parents don't understand.
青少年常用父母聽不懂的俚語。
My teacher explained the slang in the movie.
我的老師解釋了電影裡的俚語。
The two drivers slanged each other angrily at the traffic light.
兩位駕駛在紅綠燈前憤怒地互罵。
Don't slang the referee, or you'll be sent off.
別辱罵裁判，否則你會被趕出場。
She implored him to stay a little longer.
她懇求他多留一會兒。
The mother implored the doctors to help her son.
那位母親哀求醫師們救救她的兒子。
I sympathise with you, because I also lost my job last year.
我很同情你，因為我去年也失業過。
It's hard not to sympathise with a team that works so hard.
很難不同情一個這麼努力的團隊。
Many people sympathise with the protesters' demands.
許多人贊同抗議者的訴求。
He doesn't sympathise with that way of thinking.
他不認同那種想法。
We rode a snowmobile across the frozen lake.
我們騎著雪地摩托車穿越結冰的湖面。
Rescue workers used a snowmobile to reach the cabin.
救援人員騎雪地摩托車抵達了那間小木屋。

exhausting.zh: 累人的；令人筋疲力盡的
ai: It was an exhausting day full of meetings.
那是充滿會議、令人筋疲力盡的一天。
Taking care of three small kids is exhausting.
照顧三個小孩累死人了。
Don't let work encroach on your family time.
別讓工作侵占你的家庭時間。
The city keeps encroaching on the farmland around it.
城市不斷蠶食周圍的農地。
The chef skillfully cut the fish into thin slices.
主廚熟練地把魚切成薄片。
She skillfully avoided answering the difficult question.
她巧妙地避開了回答那個棘手的問題。

acknowledged.zh: 承認；認可（acknowledge 的過去式）
ai: He acknowledged that he had made a mistake.
他承認自己犯了錯。
The manager acknowledged the team's hard work in front of everyone.
經理在大家面前肯定了團隊的辛勞。
She acknowledged my email with a short reply.
她簡短回覆，表示收到了我的電子郵件。
He acknowledged the crowd with a wave of his hand.
他揮手向群眾致意。
She is an acknowledged expert on ocean life.
她是公認的海洋生物專家。
It is an acknowledged fact that exercise improves health.
運動有益健康是公認的事實。
That story is patently untrue.
那個說法顯然不是真的。
The test was patently unfair to students who hadn't been told about it.
這場考試對那些沒被告知的學生來說顯然不公平。
The flag has alternating red and white stripes.
這面旗幟有紅白相間的條紋。
They follow an alternating schedule, working week by week.
他們採輪流制的排班，一週換一次。
The author writes in a confessional style about her past.
這位作者以自白式的筆調書寫她的過去。
The singer is known for her confessional songs about love.
這位歌手以描寫愛情、坦白傾訴的歌曲聞名。
He entered the confessional and spoke quietly to the priest.
他走進告解室，低聲對神父說話。
The old church has a wooden confessional near the door.
那間老教堂的門邊有一間木製的告解室。
The critic wrote a scathing review of the film.
影評人對這部電影寫了一篇尖刻的評論。
She gave him a scathing look when he arrived late.
他遲到時，她投以嚴厲的目光。
